summary: Baan Nate is a family home cooking class near Phuket Old Town where small groups cook Thai dishes and eat together.

facts.label: Group size
facts.value: Up to five guests, private or semi-private

facts.label: Class length
facts.value: Morning class of about three to four hours, then lunch
facts.quote: Morning at 9:00, about three to four hours, then lunch. Or afternoon at 14:00.

facts.label: Menu
facts.value: Four dishes: a starter, main and dessert, plus curry paste
facts.quote: A starter, main and dessert, plus curry paste.

facts.label: Hands-on
facts.value: Every guest has a cooking station
facts.quote: Everyone has a station and cooks.

facts.label: Location
facts.value: Five minutes from Phuket Old Town
facts.quote: Five minutes from the Old Town
